references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 有少弟，弟壯，式脫身出，獨取畜羊百餘，田宅財物盡與弟。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 上以式樸忠，拜為齊王太傅，轉為相。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 會呂嘉反，式上書曰：「臣聞主愧臣死。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 明年當封禪，式又不習文章，貶秩為太子太傅，以兒寬代之。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 上乃詔寬與遷等共定漢《太初曆》。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 治《尚書》，事歐陽生。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 以郡國選詣博士，受業孔安國。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 時張湯為廷尉，廷尉府盡用文史法律之吏，而寬以儒生在其間，見謂不習事，不署曹，除為從史，之北地視畜數年。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 先是，司馬相如病死，有遺書，頌功德，言符瑞，足以封泰山。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 後太史令司馬遷等言：「歷紀壞廢，漢興未改正朔，宜可正。」
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 及至，與寬議封禪於上前，大不能及，退而服曰：「上誠知人。」
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 初，梁相褚大通《五經》，為博士，時寬為弟子。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 寬為御史大夫，以稱意任職，故久無有所匡諫於上，官屬易之。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 居位九歲，以官卒。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 贊曰：公孫弘、卜式、兒寬皆以鴻漸之翼困於燕爵，遠跡羊豕之間，非遇其時，焉能致此位乎？
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 是時，漢興六十餘載，海內艾安，府庫充實，而四夷未賓，制度多闕。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 漢之得人，於茲為盛，儒雅則公孫弘、董仲舒、兒寬，篤行則石建、石慶，質直則汲黯、卜式，推賢則韓安國、鄭當時，定令則趙禹、張湯，文章則司馬遷、相如，滑稽則東方朔、枚皋，應對則嚴助、硃買臣，歷數則唐都、洛下閎，協律則李延年，運籌則桑弘羊，奉使則張騫、蘇武，將率則衛青、霍去病，受遺則霍光、金日磾，其餘不可勝紀。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 上方欲用文武，求之如弗及，始以蒲輪迎枚生，見主父而歎息。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 卜式拔於芻牧，弘羊擢於栗豎，衛青奮於奴僕，日磾出於降虜，斯亦曩時版築飯牛之朋已。
references.reason: Fresh independent source-grounded evidence for Hanshu 068 chronology audit.

references.quote: 孝宣承統，纂修洪業，亦講論六藝，招選茂異，而蕭望之、梁丘賀、夏侯勝、韋玄成、嚴彭祖，尹更始以儒術進，劉向，王褒以文章顯，將相則張安世、趙充國、魏相、丙吉、於定國、杜延年，治民則黃霸、王成、龔遂、鄭弘、召信臣、韓延壽、尹翁歸、趙廣漢、嚴延年、張敞之屬，皆有功跡見述於世。
